text: Mac shell navigates eight destinations via the sidebar. Cmd+1..7 select Activity through Cleanup; Settings is Cmd+, and has no digit.
Servers board reflects live tracker states (running, tripped, never used, held change) without inventing figures.
When the tracker is stale, readout numbers go absent rather than displaying last-known counts as current.
The phone queues; it never installs. No path from the phone or a notification can install without explicit Mac review.
note: I4 retired; I6 keeps the boundary. Pairing transport itself is unimplemented (REQ-016).

text: Menu-bar popover renders attention rows, readout, and an inbox band (oldest first). Partial rows carry no review affordance.
Disposing an inbox item withdraws its notification banner immediately.
A multi-item arrival notification presents Review only and suppresses Decline.
Phone UI supports Discover, Triage, Queue (single-batch undo) and Library.
RouterCore manages live stdio children and HTTP upstreams with SIGTERM then SIGKILL reaping.
Authenticated loopback control API on 127.0.0.1; OAuth callback listener on 8880.
Mutations to servers.json use atomic staging and a directory lock.
Swift router agrees with the TypeScript reference on owned parity rows. Owner target is 82 of 83; fixture-registry-search is a standing exclusion.
No number is displayed that the router (or the app, for inbox) did not observe. No fabricated memory saving. Skills has no badge.
Mac pairing sheet shows an 8-character Crockford code.
Undo over confirm: reversible actions are undone, never gated behind are-you-sure. Removing a never-used server is undoable and uncounted.
Phone↔Mac pairing transport. I5 measured neither side implements it: the phone stores a paired-Mac record without contacting the Mac.
Installer cutover to the Swift binary (R4-C). Licensed only at 82 of 83; owner decision already made.
command, args and env are never writable through the control API PATCH.
Every data surface ships nine states: default, empty, loading, partial, error, success, offline (router not running), disabled, overflow.
The window title says the selected destination, not the app name.
User-facing destination title for .evals is Checks. The word Evals must not appear as a grading promise.
Hand-written OAuth client behind AuthTransport (D-p1-a). Only FakeAuthTransport exists; control-auth-post-http stays blocked.
Offline means the router is not running. Copy comes from ControlAPIError.routerNotRunning on both devices.
Apple Developer identity, signing and notarisation. Release artifacts for distribution are blocked.
